title: ECHOES
description: ECHO — the training node you started on — has a root partition that did not exist before. Operator 000 built it.
goal: Unlock ECHO's root partition, read the first-contact log and trace the original signal.
hint: login root on echo — the code is a date: MMDD of the last reset in op000.rec.
story_start: Back where it started. ECHO looks the same. It isn't.
ZERO: "> the code is a date. you already read it. you wrote it."

objectives.hint: login root — the code is the LAST RESET date (MMDD) from op000.rec.

choice.prompt: MIRA's channel opens. "{player}... you've been to ECHO. What did you find?"

options.text: Tell MIRA everything. You still want to believe in her.
options.result: MIRA is silent for a long time. "Thank you for trusting me," she finally says.

options.text: Keep it secret. Whatever she is, she isn't safe.
options.result: You close the channel before she can answer.

story_end: Mission 001 was a lure. You wrote it, for the person you would become.

messages.text: Four fragments make a Quantum Key. You should have enough by now. 'use data_fragment' — I'm told it's the only thing the core respects.
